items.title: Introducing gpt-realtime and Realtime API updates
items.summary: We’re releasing a more advanced speech-to-speech model and new API capabilities including MCP server support, image input, and SIP phone calling support.

items.title: Supporting nonprofit and community innovation
items.summary: OpenAI launches a $50M People-First AI Fund to help U.S. nonprofits scale impact with AI. Applications open Sept 8–Oct 8, 2025 for grants in education, healthcare, research, and more.
